description:
<workdir>/failure.json, written (atomically) by a runner that exits non-zero. Exit codes 2, 3 and 75 are
attributed only when this file exists.

detail.description: [stable] Human-readable detail (truncated to 4 KiB by the agent).
detail.title: Detail

fault.description: [stable] Who is at fault; overrides the exit code (job: never succeeds; host: the node lacks something; transient: retry).
fault.title: Fault

reason.description: [stable] One of the agent's end reasons: `bad_input` (the spec can never succeed), `mode_mismatch`, `oom`, `doctor` (a node dependency is missing) or `no_metrics`, which the coordinator maps to its reason codes; or the module's own `<module-short>/<code>`, which ends the attempt as `exit_nonzero` with the code kept in its detail.
reason.title: Reason

retryable.description: [beta] Overrides the exit-code attribution when set (true = transient).
retryable.title: Retryable

title: Failure
